title: The reel pane: review a plan without leaving Claude Code

frames.title: Watch it beside the conversation
frames.narration: A reelplanner video doesn't have to send you to a browser. With the plugin installed, /reel plays it in a pane right beside your conversation with Claude.

frames.title: Open a plan
frames.narration: Type /reel to list the plans that have a video, newest first, with their open choices. Pick one, or name it, and it starts playing at once.

frames.title: It stops at each choice
frames.narration: At each open choice the video stops. The question and its options sit under the picture, with the recommended one marked. Press a number to answer, m to leave a comment at that moment, and n or b to jump between stops.

frames.title: Send it back
frames.narration: The last stop sums up your review. Send it. Approve, and Claude builds the plan. Ask for changes, and Claude revises it, and the pane plays just what changed.

frames.title: Where the picture shows
frames.narration: In kitty or Ghostty the picture plays right in the terminal. Anywhere else, the pane opens the browser player and keeps the choices, comments and Send.
